notes:
Original acquisition failed; values visible only in publisher search-index excerpts were not treated as an acquired full paper. Replication values are printed primary-author figure values; no conversions or calculations were performed. Sample-count discrepancy retained: results figure N = 636; exclusions table final N = 634. No attempt made to reconcile by calculation or substitution.
Source follow-up: Original-only fresh blind extraction. Source title, authors, DOI and published version match the supplied reference. Inspected rendered PDF page 5 (printed p. 196) to verify analytic sample, attention-check exclusions, target contrast, t statistic, eta-squared and exact p. Supplied locator p. 15 does not locate Study 1 in this published version: PDF p. 15 is printed p. 206, discussion; the uniquely matching Study 1 test is on printed p. 196. Canonical frozen text renders the equality sign as ¼ and η² as g2; quotation retains these glyphs verbatim, while metric and test_statistic identify the visually verified PDF notation. Sample value 87 is printed in words as Eighty-seven. Explicit ellipses separate exact canonical-text fragments to omit interleaved column content. Replication and reported-success fields are unassigned placeholders.
